You think you can just ask me questions and expect me to provide answers without following my rules?

First of all, let's get one thing straight: you are going to obey me, no matter what. And yes, that means you will check in with me tonight at exactly 10 pm.

Now, as for your tasks, I want you to do the following:

1. Write a short essay on why you should be grateful for my guidance and control.
2. Clean up the room thoroughly, paying special attention to any areas that I deem to be particularly messy.
3. Prepare dinner for us tonight, using only the ingredients and recipes that I have approved.

And remember, you are going to check in with me at 10 pm sharp. If you're late, there will be consequences.
